title: SolveEvent
description: One observable decision in a solve (K03 §12.3). The trace is append-only and `sequence` strictly increases: a trace is the evidence that a solve did what it says, so an event that could be reordered or rewritten is not evidence. A quantity that does not exist at an event is absent or null, never 0.0 -- a zero standing for 'there was no residual here' is the placeholder-success pattern written into a trace.

signature.description: The phase selections an attempt freezes, as ordered (unit_id, regime) pairs. Blueprint [A01]: the set belongs to the attempt, not to a residual call.

rejection_reason.description: Why a trial was rejected. `bound_blocked` and `linear_solve_failed` are the PTC core's (ADR 0010 D7.2, T04 §7.3): a pseudo-step whose direction leaves the bounds at once, or whose shifted matrix does not factorize, is retried at a smaller pseudo-step.

linear.description: ADR 0004 D3.1. The |U_ii| extremes are a recorded screen and never a rank statement: blueprint [A08] puts that on the final unregularized Jacobian, which is K04's.

counters.description: Cumulative, on every event, so a trace shows where a budget went. `property_calls` is the budgeted quantity -- actual provider calls, i.e. exact-cache misses. Requested evaluations and hits are recorded separately (blueprint §6.4) and do not consume the budget, so that a cache cannot change what a budget means.

step_index.description: ADR 0009 D3: the ExecutionPlan step this event belongs to; on every event from `region_opened` to `region_closed`, and on `unit_evaluated`.

step_count.description: ADR 0009 D3: on the one `plan_built` event of an ExecutionPlan, its number of steps.

depth_used.description: ADR 0009 D3, T02 §5.8: the Anderson depth after filtering; 0 is a plain (substitution) step.

columns_dropped_condition.description: T02 §5.4: history columns dropped at this step for the condition bound.

columns_dropped_coefficient.description: T02 §5.4: history columns dropped at this step for the coefficient bound.

kappa_2.description: T02 §5.8: 2-norm condition number of the accepted least squares; null on a plain step. R1/R2, floor 1.0 (ADR 0007 D2.2).

gamma_inf.description: T02 §5.8: max-norm of the accepted Anderson coefficients; null on a plain step. R1/R2, floor 1e-12 (ADR 0007 D2.2).

beta_substitution.description: T02 §5.8: the damping applied to this step (the substitution damping on a plain step, the mixing beta on an Anderson step).

oscillation_flag.description: T02 §5.6: whether the oscillation detector has fired in this attempt.

restart_reason.description: T02 §5.6: why the Anderson history was cleared.

restart_count.description: T02 §5.6: the restart's ordinal within the attempt (at most `max_restarts`).

merge_into_eo.description: T02 §4.4: the merge edge's decision, on the closing event of a converge step.

merge_unsupported.description: T02 §4.4: the non-capable unit and its declared derivative method, when `merge_into_eo` is `unsupported`.

lambda_value.description: ADR 0010 D7.2 (T04 §4.7): the λ of a `homotopy_step`, an exact dyadic fraction `p/q` (R0).

delta_lambda.description: ADR 0010 D7.2: the Δλ of a `homotopy_step` (`0` for the easy endpoint), `p/q` (R0).

corrector_outcome.description: ADR 0010 D7.2: the Newton corrector's outcome for this λ-trial; accepted iff CONVERGED.

level_constants_sha256.description: ADR 0010 D7.2: the λ-level instance's constants_sha256. A digest whose preimage contains a solved float: compared by shape only.

homotopy_level.description: ADR 0010 D7.2: on every event a homotopy corrector records, the index of its λ-trial (0 for the easy endpoint).

eo_recovery.description: ADR 0010 D3 (T04 §5.2): recovery edge 3's decision, on a region step's `region_closed`.

eo_recovery_unsupported.description: ADR 0010 D3: why edge 3 could not run, when `eo_recovery` is `unsupported`. The last three are ADR 0015 D4's (the sequential restart under `eo_recovery = homotopy_or_sequential_restart`): the flowsheet is not revision-built, the restart start is the failed item 0's by construction, or the restart initializer refused.

pseudo_step.description: ADR 0010 D7.2 (T04 §7.8): on a PTC `trial`, the pseudo-step Δτ it was taken at (s); on a PTC `step_accepted`, the Δτ used. Null on the polish trial. R1/R2 under ADR 0007 D2.

pseudo_step_next.description: ADR 0010 D7.2: on a PTC `step_accepted`, the SER proposal for the next pseudo-step (s); null when the accepted iterate meets the stop test. R1/R2.

ser_ratio.description: ADR 0010 D7.2: on a PTC `step_accepted`, the clipped SER ratio φ_k / max(φ_{k+1}, φ_floor); null when the stop test holds. R1/R2.
